title: skills: the actionLayout teaching overstates where os validate judges a name, and objectstack-data omits actionLayout from the pair-only keys
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYo86w1wqy2z2fMrryr

Follow-up of #36630 (PR #37043), from its contract review 7139491356 (nit N2 and a note read outside the diff). Filing agreed by the seat session; the zone that filed it takes it.

## What is wrong (readings at `b01d8f97`, plus PR #37043's head `63287424a2` for the new sentence)

1. **The `os validate` sentence is unqualified.** PR #37043's section in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` says "`os validate` refuses a name the arm's scope does not place", and the next sentence teaches the paired `.custom` extension writing `actionLayout` on an installed object. `validateObjectActionLayout` (`packages/lint/src/validate-object-action-layout.ts`, docblock line 27) judges an extension only against an object the same stack defines; an extension of an object the stack does not define is skipped (pin: `validate-object-action-layout.test.ts` line 75, "skips one whose object the stack does not define"). So on the `.custom` path the skill describes next, a wrong name draws nothing from `os validate`, and the arm just skips it at run time. An agent reading the two sentences together expects a refusal it will not get.
2. **objectstack-data lists two of the three pair-only keys.** `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` line 385 says "Only the pair's extension may also write `fieldGroups` and `relatedLists`". `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS` (`packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts`) now holds `actionLayout` as the third. PR #37043 points from objectstack-ui at that sentence ("as `fieldGroups`, objectstack-data"), so the target now under-states the rule it is cited for.

## Done when

- The objectstack-ui sentence says where `os validate` judges the names (the object's own key, and an extension of an object the same stack defines) and that an installed object's `.custom` extension is not judged there, in the fewest words.
- The objectstack-data sentence names `actionLayout` beside `fieldGroups` and `relatedLists`.
- Token ratchet green with no ceiling raised unless paid down first in the same file (standing ruling, record 6513306068).

Blocked-by: #37043 (the objectstack-ui sentence lands there first)

## Grade

Suggested-grade: p3 · two teaching gaps in published skills; neither makes an author write metadata the runtime refuses (the placement rule itself is taught correctly).
Suggested-domain: `domain:skills`
